subject: Airlock & SegNet RFI — private network options, SOC 2 status, next steps
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paul Ritter <paul.ritter@helixbio.com>, Marcy Lin <marcy.lin@helixbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Airlock & SegNet RFI — private network options, SOC 2 status, next steps

Hi Paul / Marcy —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary from our side:
- HelixBio is evaluating a private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with strong isolation — you used the terms "airlock" and "segmented network (SegNet)".
- Primary requirements we heard: network isolation between model-serving and customer data stores, option for fully air-gapped workflows for select workloads, and proof points for SOC 2 / HIPAA readiness.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm current SOC 2 status (Type I/II, last audit date) and whether you can share a redacted summary or SOC 2 bridge letter.
2) Share a basic network sketch (VPC + subnets + NAT/firewall boundaries) showing how Helix plans to isolate inference workers from internet-accessible services. A hand-drawn PNG is fine.
3) Complete the attached SegNet RFI (segnet-rfi.xlsx) with answers for KMS usage, key rotation, egress controls, and on-prem agent management.
4) If air-gapped option is needed, indicate which workloads and whether physical media transfer is acceptable.

Ben / Neha — please review the RFI once Paul sends it and flag any must-have constraints (encryption ciphers, KMS type, approved HSM vendors).

Proposed timeline: if Helix can get the RFI + sketch + SOC artefact by EOD Thursday (2028-03-30), Mateo will circle back with a follow-up call slot for early next week.

Attachments: segnet-rfi.xlsx (RFI template)

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

----

From: Paul Ritter <paul.ritter@helixbio.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcy Lin <marcy.lin@helixbio.com>, security@helixbio.com
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 13:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Airlock & SegNet RFI — private network options, SOC 2 status, next steps

Mateo —

Thanks for the concise recap. Quick answers inline: 

- SOC 2: HelixBio completed SOC 2 Type II for infrastructure controls last quarter (audit period ended 2027-12-31). We can share a redacted summary (SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf) and a short bridge letter; will attach a PDF redaction by EOD.
- Network sketch: attaching a simple topology sketch (network-sketch-v1.png) showing SegNet (inference enclave), customer data subnet, and an administrative bastion.
- RFI: we’ll start filling the SegNet RFI this afternoon and return a completed spreadsheet by Thursday. For KMS — we use AWS KMS in our cloud footprint and Thales Luna for on-prem HSMs. Egress is locked down via egress proxies and firewall rules — we’ll detail IP ranges in the RFI.

On air-gapped flows: we have a limited program that accepts offline model refreshes (signed artifacts transferred via encrypted media). We can mark which internal workloads can follow that pattern.

I’ll send the SOC2 redaction and a preliminary RFI draft shortly.

—Paul
Paul Ritter
Head of IT Security | HelixBio
paul.ritter@helixbio.com

----

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Paul Ritter <paul.ritter@helixbio.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Airlock & SegNet RFI — private network options, SOC 2 status, next steps

Paul —

Appreciate the quick reply and the sketch. A few clarifying questions to help us size the Private deployment and lock down requirements in the RFI: 

1) KMS + Keys: please indicate whether keys for inference tokens and KV caches are customer-managed (CMK) or Helix-managed. If customer-managed, which KMS APIs will you expose (AWS KMS, PKCS#11 for HSM)?
2) TLS / mTLS: will you support mutual TLS between the inference workers and upstream customer data stores? If yes, how are client certificates issued/rotated?
3) Data-at-rest encryption scope: confirm whether ephemeral KV caches are encrypted with separate keys and what TTLs are expected.
4) Network enforcement: do you have a zero-trust enforcement point (proxy sidecar / IP allowlist / firewall appliance)? The network-sketch suggests a firewall + egress proxy but we need to know whether there are policy enforcement points at L7.

If you can drop short answers into the RFI spreadsheet, that will let us produce a concrete deployment proposal and any additional SOC/HIPAA addenda.

Thanks — I’ll review the SOC2 redaction when available and follow up with a short checklist of any gaps we commonly see in private deployments.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:10:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Airlock & SegNet RFI — private network options, SOC 2 status, next steps

Forwarding the sketch Paul attached — couple quick technical notes: 

- The "inference enclave" in the sketch should be treated as a segmented compute tier with strict egress policies. Recommend a dedicated VPC peering connection and no internet NAT from that subnet for production airlock mode.
- For on-prem, the recommended pattern is a local HSM (Thales) + isolated LAN where the model serving hosts have no route to the corporate internet; use a one-way data diode for any outbound telemetry (if allowed).
- Attached a small draft topology file (network-sketch-v1.png) with labels for where we’d place the KV encryption layer and the sidecar enforcing egress control.

Ben Carter
Lead Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: network-sketch-v1.png (sketch, 420KB stub)

Subject: Re: Airlock & SegNet RFI — private network options, SOC 2 status, next steps

Paul / Marcy —

Thanks — we received the SOC2 redaction and the preliminary RFI draft. Neha and Ben have a couple of follow-ups (see inline comments in the RFI) but overall this looks good. Quick summary of agreed next actions: 

- Helix to finalize RFI and return completed segnet-rfi.xlsx with inline answers by Thu 2028-03-30 COB.
- Helix to confirm whether keys will be customer-managed for production (CMK) or Helix-managed. If CMK, include required KMS support in the RFI form.
- Redwood to produce a short deployment options doc: 1) VPC-resident with dedicated VPC peering, 2) On‑prem airlocked cluster with HSM + one-way telemetry, and 3) Hybrid (models updated via encrypted media). Expect that doc on Monday 2028-04-01.
- Schedule: propose 30-min technical dial on Monday 2028-04-01 16:00 PDT to review final RFI answers and the deployment options doc. Please confirm availability.

If anything changes on your side, reply-all and we’ll re-schedule.

Thanks again — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Mateo
